description: Focuses on statistical modeling, time series forecasting, survival analysis, and predictive feature engineering across commercial and industrial domains.
learning_objectives: Formulate predictive modeling workflows, feature engineering, and cross-validation strategies.
Master multiple linear regression, regularized regression (Lasso/Ridge/ElasticNet), and GLMs.
Model time series data using ARIMA, SARIMA, exponential smoothing, and deep neural forecasters.
Apply survival analysis, customer churn modeling, and predictive maintenance techniques.
outline: Predictive Modeling Lifecycle: Data exploration, feature engineering, imputation, outlier handling, cross-validation.
Regression Models: Multiple linear regression, Ridge, Lasso, ElasticNet, Generalized Linear Models (GLM), logistic regression.
Time Series Analytics: Stationarity, ACF/PACF, ARIMA, SARIMA, VAR models, exponential smoothing, Prophet, deep time series models.
Survival Analysis: Kaplan-Meier estimator, Cox proportional hazards model, accelerated failure time models.
Applications: Churn prediction, credit scoring, demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, uplift modeling.

books.title: Time Series Analysis: Forecasting and Control
books.author: George E. P. Box, Gwilym M. Jenkins, Gregory C. Reinsel, Greta M. Ljung

books.title: Applied Logistic Regression
books.author: David W. Hosmer Jr., Stanley Lemeshow, Rodney X. Sturdivant
